function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT pl.period, SUM(pl.amount_cad) AS total_cost_cad, SUM(pl.qty) AS total_qty, SUM(pl.amount_cad)/SUM(pl.qty) AS avg_unit_cost_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
WHERE pl.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY pl.period
ORDER BY pl.period","purpose":"Average unit cost purchased (CAD) for Aug and Sep 2026"}
